description: Fetch one URL from a residential IP and get the raw response as JSON: status, final URL, headers and body (text or base64), up to 10 MB. GET, HEAD or POST, your own headers, an optional country. No JavaScript rendering. You pay for the megabytes delivered; a fetch that fails is not charged. Pay per call in stablecoins.

body.description: request body for POST, sent as given

country.description: exit country, a two-letter code such as DE or US (default: anywhere)

headers.description: request headers; Host, Content-Length, Connection, Accept-Encoding and proxy headers are set by the service

max_mb.description: most megabytes of the response to return and pay for; a longer body is cut and flagged truncated

url.description: the http or https URL to fetch

name: fetch
title: Raw fetch from a residential IP
